description: List merchant crypto payment sessions with optional filtering by status (pending, completed, expired, failed), currency, network, and pagination.

currency.description: Filter by token symbol (e.g., USDT, USDC).

limit.description: Number of sessions to return per page (1-100).

network.description: Filter by blockchain network key (e.g., tron-mainnet, solana-mainnet).

status.description: Filter by session status (pending, processing, completed, expired, failed).

name: xpayr_list_payment_sessions
